m10.text: Doug Beyer, a member of Wizards' creative team, spends a working day on small rulings, as he rules in his head that a Griffin cannot be a Soldier and records the verdict in the Multiverse database.
He suggests that a blue sleep spell should have duration, and Aaron Forsythe makes the change, and his lunch hour turns into an impromptu card design session with fellow R&D members.

Brady Dommermuth drops off a printout of a planeswalker sketch for a set a year away, and the team critiques it, and later developers play handwritten prototype decks by window light, with one asking Doug whether a Wurm can be a Warrior.
